en: A vintage postcard showing a large, open public square surrounded by historic buildings. In the center background is a prominent domed structure with a tower, likely a former mosque or religious building, now with Christian elements. The square is lined with trees, people, and horse-drawn carriages, suggesting an early 20th-century scene. The text in Hungarian at the bottom reads 'Széchenyi-tér, Pécs.' There is also publisher information in Hungarian along the left margin.
